description: Prepare a six-question evidence-grounded review packet for an authorized decision owner about compliance-framework commitment, an annual audit calendar, evidence consolidation, mock-audit review, management-review decisions, or certification-stage-1 sign-off.

provenance.author: LiNKskills adaptation
provenance.source: Pinned Alireza six-question entrypoint, package README, and exact MIT notice copied with file hashes in references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json.
provenance.license: See source manifest and exact notice. No separate license approval gate or publication clearance claim.

routing.when_to_use: Review a proposed compliance-program decision and prepare six evidence-backed question assessments and owner options.
when_not_to_use: Named audit-window gap sequencing; route to compliance-framework-compliance-readiness.
Standing framework portfolio, control/evidence architecture, recurring program backlog, or annual calendar design; route to compliance-framework-compliance-os.
A request for binding legal determination, certification, official audit opinion, or policy adoption.
exclusion_rules: Unknown applicability remains unknown until supported by current authority and company facts.
ambiguity_rules: Continue separable evidence review; record missing facts and owner roles.

required_inputs.name: task_request
required_inputs.description: Decision under review and requested packet.

required_inputs.name: program_name
required_inputs.description: Program/entity label from the request; may explicitly be unknown.

required_inputs.name: company_context
required_inputs.description: Confirmed organizational facts or explicit unknowns.

required_inputs.name: applicability_context
required_inputs.description: Jurisdictions, population, obligation, scope, and as-of facts or explicit unknowns.

required_inputs.name: candidate_frameworks
required_inputs.description: Names, asserted basis, scope, and evidence references.

required_inputs.name: source_documents
required_inputs.description: Authorized program evidence and source/date details.

required_inputs.name: evidence_inventory
required_inputs.description: Artifact, owner, period/date, and source reference.

required_inputs.name: audit_calendar
required_inputs.description: Proposed review events, dates, auditor roles, and source references.

required_inputs.name: mock_audit_record
required_inputs.description: Observed sample and findings or explicit absence.

required_inputs.name: management_review_record
required_inputs.description: Supplied cadence, decisions, actions, owners, or explicit absence.

expected_outputs.name: question_assessments
expected_outputs.description: Exactly six typed evidence and owner-decision assessments.

expected_outputs.name: decision_options
expected_outputs.description: Nonbinding options with trade-offs and authorized decision-owner choices; none selected by this review.

expected_outputs.name: conflicts
expected_outputs.description: Contradictions between supplied records, with source references.

expected_outputs.name: missing_inputs
expected_outputs.description: Required unresolved facts and the owner role to obtain them.

expected_outputs.name: unknown_facts
expected_outputs.description: Unknowns with explanation and source references.

expected_outputs.name: open_questions_and_partial_work
expected_outputs.description: Questions for the owner and independently completed portions.

forbidden_actions: This review does not choose, commit, schedule, certify, approve, sign, notify, file, or update official records. It records prior decisions only when authority is evidenced and preserves decisions reserved to Carlos.
No invented authority, applicability, policy, dates, thresholds, outcomes, or evidence.
No source scripts, unverified APIs, or connector aliases are callable task tools.
verification_steps: Trace findings to supplied evidence references.
Check framework basis, jurisdiction and as-of details or mark unknown.
Check owner and auditor independence facts; do not infer from title alone.
Compare mock-audit findings only to supplied owner-approved criteria.
Validate all six question assessments, options, and empty effects/mutations.
completion_criteria: All six assessments contain task-specific evidence-backed findings or explicit unknowns.
Decision options identify trade-offs and the authorized decision owner without selecting an option.
No unsupported applicability, readiness, compliance, or certification conclusion.
Typed output passes references/schemas.json and external_effects/mutations are empty.
known_limitations: Copied upstream scripts are archived_support only and are not exposed or callable task tools.
No current-law, framework applicability, runtime, legal, audit, or semantic certification is asserted.

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
